channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Primo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Primo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Josh Primo
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Mike Budenholzer on what he thinks is getting Spurs through the adversity stemming from the Primo controversy:

“Character is always one of the first words that comes out of the Spurs organization... Intough times, your character shows. You want to have people with character.”

Mike Budenholzer on Josh Primo, Nov 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Josh Primo
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop said if,

“I could really do what I wanted, and I didn't care about anything else in the world, I'd throw (Primo) in the frying pan the way we did Tony Parker.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Josh Primo, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Derrick White on Josh Primo
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Derrick White on Josh Primo:

“He’s pretty mature for an 18 year old. He just comes in and puts the work in. He’s been great just coming in working, learning, listening and asking questions. He’s young and his potential is to the roof. Just keep working and trust the process.”

Derrick White on Josh Primo, Oct 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Josh Primo
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Mitch Johnson on Joshua Primo's defense:

“I think he’s shown the ability to keep people in front laterally.”

Mitch Johnson on Josh Primo, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Josh Primo
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Mitch Johnson on Joshua Primo's passing ability:

“I think his passing is supernatural. He can pass with both hands off the dribble, get in the paint.”

Mitch Johnson on Josh Primo, Aug 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.
